title: Token overrides definition
description: Shared token-override map used by anatomy parts, variant values, and states. Keys name the visual attribute; values MUST use DTCG alias syntax in braces (ex: '{color.action.primary}'). Token references MUST name a documented token, never a raw value.

tokenOverrides.description: Token overrides for one part, variant value, or state. Keys name the visual attribute (ex: 'background', 'text-color', 'border-radius'); values MUST be DTCG alias references in braces (ex: '{color.action.primary}', '{radius.md}'). Braces mark the value as a token reference consistently with design-specifications values — the same rule applies everywhere: bare string = raw literal, braced string = token reference. When the system documents a token layer, each value MUST resolve to a documented token. Raw values (ex: '#ffffff', '4px') are not allowed here — token-less systems put those in design-specifications.
